name: ReliefRequestTriage
tagline: Disaster relief requests – priority scoring, kits, dispatch and confirmed delivery in one app.
description: A complete relief request app for NGOs and emergency responders in one Power Apps component: request intake from hotline, SMS, web and field teams, a transparent priority score with overrides and target times, duplicate checks and verification, aid kit assignment against live warehouse stock, dispatch planning per truck, boat or partner team with loading lists, and delivery confirmation with recipient codes. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Transparent priority score with breakdown and overrides
Target time per priority band with at-risk and breached flags
Kit suggestions from needs and household size
Live kit stock with low-stock and over-allocation warnings
Dispatch plan per team with loading list and manifest CSV
Delivery confirmation with method, unique recipient codes and partial deliveries
Bulk verify / assign team / dispatch / export, undo, audit history
